Moltology is a daily practice of shedding distraction and growing protective boundaries around attention, visualized through deep ocean and crustacean armor. Create a dark, mysterious, sophisticated cinematic abstract image: a vast broken carapace suspended in near-black ocean water, layered crescent plates of midnight chitin opening around a small still turquoise inner core. Chaotic fine shards and currents near the upper edges settle into coherent protective shell layers at depth. The shell is readable as crustacean armor but also feels like a mind becoming calm. No literal brain, people, monster or machinery. Sculptural macro detail, organic mineral texture, faint cyan rim light, tiny warm amber reflection. Asymmetric shell arcs flank the frame, middle 55% very dark and low detail for centered white headline and paragraph. Hints of surface turbulence at top, still depth below. Very dark ink navy #020408, muted teal, restrained bioluminescence. No text, logos, interface, watermark. Strong negative space, premium art direction, not a bright coral landscape.
